findings.claim: Removing the `type Unwrap as TRPCUnwrap` re-export drops a publicly reachable type from the package entrypoint, which is a breaking change for any consumer (or sibling package such as @trpc/client / @trpc/react-query / generated .d.ts files) that imports `TRPCUnwrap` from `@trpc/server`.
findings.rationale: Even though the export is annotated `@internal`, it was part of the emitted public type surface of `packages/server/src/@trpc/server/index.ts`. Deleting it will cause `TS2305: Module '@trpc/server' has no exported member 'TRPCUnwrap'` for downstream imports, and can also break declaration emit in other packages whose inferred types referenced this alias. I could not verify remaining references from the hunk alone, so this is a suspicion rather than a confirmed break — worth grepping for `TRPCUnwrap` across the monorepo, docs, and any API-report/`.api.md` snapshot before landing, and if it truly is going away it likely belongs in a semver-major/changeset note.
